response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS o FROM ev), kept AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amt FROM ev, overall WHERE ev.avg_amt > overall.o), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS m FROM kept) SELECT kept.link_to_event, kept.avg_amt AS avg_amount, kept.avg_amt - overall.o AS above_overall_avg, kept.avg_amt - km.m AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept, overall, km ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
